name: shape functions
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 将单元节点自由度映射到单元内部位移场的插值函数。
usage_note: 本文用于不同长度轨道板与桥梁单元耦合积分，须核对各自局部坐标。
usage_overview: 用于将节点自由度插值到单元内部、轮轨接触点或层间支承位置，进而构造单元矩阵和耦合关系。连接不同网格或不同构件时，它还承担位移映射的作用。

complete_examples.text: It should be noted that the shape functions are generally sparse vectors, and apart from those elements corresponding to four DOFs of the two nodes of the beam element, all other elements are zero.
With above parameters, the cubic Hermitian and linear interpolation polynomials are used as the shape functions.
For other DOFs in dr; j; i, their vibrational responses are calculated by the nodal response through the shape functions following finite element principle.
